situation: An Indian passport printed the whole name in the Given Name field and left Surname blank, which does not match other documents and causes trouble with foreign visa and travel forms.

remedies_reported.name: At a Passport Seva Kendra, apply for re-issue under 'change in particulars' (Others), asking for the name to be split into given name and surname
Abroad, apply by post to the Indian consulate with the old passport, photos and supporting documents to have the name split
Fill the name in the correct fields on a fresh application

conflict_note: Forum users report that one office refused to split the name on a fresh application while another did it as a re-issue. Official Passport Seva pages reviewed do not describe this case.

source.title: Immihelp forum: How can I get my name corrected in the Indian passport

your_summary: A passport put the full name under Given Name with no surname. In one reply, the passport office had refused to split a name even though the form was filled correctly, and the change was later made through a consulate abroad. In another, a reissue at a Passport Seva Kendra asking for the name to be split was reported as quick.
